lines.preview_differs.en: The lines changed after the preview, so nothing was changed. Check the new preview, then confirm again.

documents.lines_changed_since_confirm.en: The lines changed while this confirm was open, so nothing was changed. This is what the action does now:

documents.will_take_back_one.en: Line {lines} has already shipped: this takes its goods back into stock and reverses its shipment.

documents.will_take_back_many.en: Lines {lines} have already shipped: this takes their goods back into stock and reverses their shipments.

documents.taken_back_one.en: Line {lines} had already shipped, so its goods came back into stock and its shipment was reversed.

documents.taken_back_many.en: Lines {lines} had already shipped, so their goods came back into stock and their shipments were reversed.

documents.scanned_lines_skipped_one.en: Line {lines} was already marked as scanned, so it was left as it is.

documents.scanned_lines_skipped_many.en: Lines {lines} were already marked as scanned, so they were left as they are.

documents.unscanned_lines_skipped_one.en: Line {lines} wasn't marked as scanned, so there was nothing to clear.

documents.unscanned_lines_skipped_many.en: Lines {lines} weren't marked as scanned, so there was nothing to clear.

documents.drawn_lines_skipped_one.en: Line {lines} was invoiced from a memo and its products are already with the customer, so it was left as it is.

documents.drawn_lines_skipped_many.en: Lines {lines} were invoiced from a memo and their products are already with the customer, so they were left as they are.
